gaps.quoted_evidence: Holland & Barrett - approximately 100 stores in London supported with e-cargo bikes and inventory analytics software
gaps.reasoning: The company's flagship named account is a large multi-site enterprise retailer, indicating a complex, multi-stakeholder sales motion (procurement, operations, sustainability sign-off across ~100 stores). The named team consists of a CEO, COO, Head of Development and Head of Operations, none of which carry an enterprise sales, account management, or commercial title.
gaps.what_goes_wrong: Without someone experienced in navigating enterprise procurement and multi-stakeholder buying committees, expansion within accounts like Holland & Barrett or replication with similar large retailers stalls, and deals get stuck in pilot purgatory.
gaps.name: Enterprise and complex sales
gaps.covers: Multi stakeholder deals, procurement, security reviews, long cycles.
gaps.profile: Has closed six figure contracts into regulated or large organisations. Knows what a security questionnaire and a DPA do to a deal cycle.

gaps.quoted_evidence: Next-generation inventory ecosystem for urban retail with sustainable, zero-emissions delivery

demotions.contradicting_evidence: Lili Kyuchuk-Pakyuz holds the title Co-Founder & COO. While COO is an operations title rather than a sales/revenue title, the presence of a named COO directly contradicts the claim that there is no commercial leadership. A COO at a company with an active paying customer (Holland & Barrett) is evidence of commercial operations ownership, even if not titled 'Chief Revenue Officer' or 'VP Sales'. The claim conflates 'no sales title' with 'no commercial leadership', which are distinct.

notes_for_human: Evidence is thin (a 4-person team page and one customer logo). Several plausible gaps (finance, operations/supply chain depth, technical leadership) were considered but not included because the existing titles (COO, Head of Operations, Head of Development) plausibly already cover those functions, and rule 5 requires treating a filled role as a disqualifier absent evidence it's inadequate. Confidence is capped at medium throughout since only single-source, indirect evidence was available.
